{{Top}}
A '''suit''' was a style of clothing. It could be made from [[plesticene]]. One type of suit was the [[Dervdisi fashioned suit]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Cantryl]] was noted for wearing white suits.<ref name="DIRP">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Death Is Remotely Possible|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
